target.title: Show OpenCode Go monthly pace
target.body:
## Summary

- show pace status and projected run-out details on the OpenCode Go monthly row
- reuse the existing billing-cycle pace calculation shared with Cursor
- keep OpenCode Go's 5-hour row unchanged, limiting the fix to the reported monthly gap
- add deterministic menu-card model coverage

Fixes #1863.

## Behavior proof

The issue screenshot shows Weekly with `On pace` / `Lasts until reset`, while Monthly has no pace detail despite carrying a 30-day duration and reset date.

The new model fixture builds that production menu path at the midpoint of a 30-day window with 75% used. The resulting Monthly metric is now:

```text
Monthly
25% in deficit
Runs out in 5d
pace marker: 50%
```

The focused model suite executes this UI-model path without browser cookies, Keychain reads, or a live provider account.

## Testing

- `swift test --disable-sandbox --filter OpenCodeGoMenuCardModelTests` (4 passed)
- `swift test --disable-sandbox --filter UsagePaceTextTests` (21 passed)
- `swift test --disable-sandbox --filter MenuBarPaceTextTests` (2 passed)
- `make check` (0 formatting or lint violations)
- `make test` (run started; any environment-only baseline failure will be reported here)
